Frequently Asked Questions

Q:What is the Fated Summon event in Empires & Puzzles?

Fated Summon is a recurring event where every summon you make earns credits toward a meter. Once the meter is full, you can pick one guaranteed Legendary (5★) hero from a rotating pool. Credits carry over between events but expire after a set period.

Q:How many summons do I need for a Fated Summon?

You need to accumulate enough credits to fill the Fated Summon meter. Each summon type awards different credit amounts. Generally, it takes around 100–150 summons to fill the meter, though the exact number depends on the types of summons you perform.

Q:Do Fated Summon credits carry over?

Yes, Fated Summon credits carry over between events. However, they do expire after a certain period. Check the in-game timer to see when your credits will reset.

Q:How do I choose the best hero from the Fated Summon pool?

Use the Empuzzled Hero Database to compare heroes in the Fated Summon pool. Consider your roster gaps, the hero Tier List rankings, and whether the hero synergizes with your existing team composition. Focus on heroes that fill a role you lack rather than duplicating strengths.
